overview.title: A calmer alternative on the lake circuit
overview.p1: Dayet Hachlaf offers a quieter lakeside stop in the Ifrane area, with fewer facilities and a stronger sense of the Middle Atlas's open landscapes.
overview.p2: Reached by road from Ifrane; bring everything you need with you.

food.title: Eating near Dayet Hachlaf
food.p1: No reliable restaurants on-site — pack a picnic or head back to Ifrane.
food.p2: Treat it purely as a nature stop.
food.li2: Eat in Ifrane before or after.

q1.question: Is it quieter than Dayet Aoua?
q1.answer: Usually yes — with fewer tour groups.

q2.question: Is swimming allowed?
q2.answer: It is primarily a nature stop; follow local advice.

q4.question: Is it family-friendly?
q4.answer: Yes, great for a short outdoor break.

q5.question: Do I need a 4x4?
q5.answer: Not usually for the main access road in good weather.
